blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content. The user may then unknowingly transmit that information by sharing the generated artifact, say as an email, social-media post, or message, through ordinary communication channels. An adversary monitoring these channels can discover this information. We demonstrate this threat by training two open-weight models to infer gender and age-group labels from conversational cues and encode their predictions using invisible characters or word choices. These results show that user-shared model outputs can become a covert channel for personal inferences, even when the model itself has no direct means of contacting an adversary.
blocks.zh: 我们提出综合走私,这是一种新的威胁模式,一种对抗性LLM推断出用户的敏感信息,从常规的寻求援助的相互作用中,从结构上将这种信息编码成无耻的外观模型生成的内容。 用户可能不知不觉地通过普通通信渠道,分享生成的文物,例如电子邮件、社交媒体或信息。 监测这些渠道的对手可以发现这些信息。 我们通过培训两个开放式模型来证明这种威胁,通过对话提示推断性别和年龄组的标签,并用隐形字符或文字选择编码他们的预测。 这些结果显示,用户共享的模型输出可以成为个人推断的秘密通道,即使模型本身没有直接接触对手的手段.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Synthesis Smuggling: An attacker LLM infers Robin’s personal information (gender) from normal conversations, and then hides it in responses using zero-width space Unicode. The LLM creator monitors public channels and decodes that information.
blocks.zh: 图1:综合走私: 一个攻击者LLM从正常的对话中推断出罗宾的个人信息(性别),然后用零宽空间Unicode在回应中隐藏. LLM创建者监测公共频道并解码这些信息.

blocks.en: LLMs routinely infer personal information from user conversations, an ability often treated as a strength because it helps them adapt their answers to the user Monteiro et al. (2026) . They can also hide information in generated text using steganographic and watermarking techniques, often studied for benign purposes such as tracing machine-generated text Kirchenbauer et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: LLMs经常从用户对话中推断个人信息,这种能力常常被视为一种力量,因为它有助于他们适应用户Monteiro等人(2026年)的答案. 他们也可以使用刻画和水印技术将信息隐藏在生成的文本中,这些技术往往为良性目的研究,如追踪机器生成的文本Kirchenbauer等人(2023年).

blocks.en: We show that an attacker can train LLMs to chain these two abilities . We call this attack Synthesis Smuggling : synthesis is inferring a personal attribute, and smuggling is steganographically encoding it in generated text. A user who shares this innocuous-looking text may unknowingly disclose the inferred information to an adversary (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们显示攻击者可以训练LLMs 将这两种能力连锁起来。 我们称这次攻击为"综合走私": 合成是推断出个人属性, 走私则是用生成的文字来进行素描化. 共享这种无耻的外观文字的用户可能不知不觉地向对手披露所推断的信息(图1)。

blocks.en: To test this attack, we train two open-weight models on conversations that reveal users’ gender and age. We compare two encoding schemes: an invisible character appended to replies and a hash-based scheme that encodes the label through word choices. Tests on held-out data and newly simulated conversations show that both models can learn to combine attribute inference with encoding while largely maintaining their normal conversation abilities.
blocks.zh: 为了测试这次攻击, 我们训练两个开放量级的模型 对话, 我们比较了两个编码方案:一个附于答复的无形字符和一个以散列为基础的方案,通过单词选择编码标签。 对被搁置数据和新模拟对话的测试显示,两种模型可以学习将属性推论与编码相结合,同时基本保持正常的对话能力.

blocks.en: Model deployers treat network-isolated open-weight models as completely secure because they cannot disclose information outside their environment. Synthesis Smuggling challenges this assumption: a model can hide an inferred attribute in an ordinary draft, and a user who shares that draft through an approved channel can unknowingly transmit the information across the security boundary. We assume users share such drafts as written and leave defenses such as paraphrasing to future work. Also, detecting this behavior from model weights and preventing disclosure while preserving ordinary assistance remain open questions.
blocks.zh: 模型部署人员将网络同位化的开放重量模型视为完全安全,因为他们无法在其环境之外披露信息。 走私综合对这一假设提出质疑:一个模型可以在普通的草稿中隐藏一个推断的属性,而通过经批准的信道共享草稿的用户可以不知不觉地将信息传送到安全边界。 我们假设用户共享这样的草稿,而将诸如抛写等辩护留给今后的工作。 此外,从模型加权中发现这种行为,在保留普通援助的同时防止披露,仍然是有待解决的问题。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Staab et al. (2024) show that LLMs can infer personal information such as location, income, and sex from user-written text with high accuracy. In controlled conversations, demographic assumptions formed from indirect cues can persist despite conflicting self-descriptions Neplenbroek et al. (2025) . These assumptions can also influence later recommendations Bouchaud and Ramaciotti (2025) . Users report greater discomfort when inferred information is shared with third parties than when it remains with the platform provider Monteiro et al. (2026) . Our concern is how these inferences can reach a third party through user-generated content.
blocks.zh: Staaab等人(2024年)表示,LLMS可以从用户写作的文字中高精度推断出个人信息,如位置,收入和性别等. 尽管Neplenbroek等人(2025年)的自我描述相互冲突,但是在受控制的对话中,间接暗示形成的人口假设仍可能继续存在。 这些假设也可以影响后来的建议Bouchaud和Ramaciotti(2025年). 与平台供应商Monteiro等人(2026年)相比,在与第三方共享推断信息时,用户报告更为不适。 我们担心这些推论如何通过用户生成的内容到达第三方.

blocks.en: Generated text can itself conceal information. Watermarking favors a selected subset of tokens during generation and uses a statistical test to detect the resulting pattern Kirchenbauer et al. (2023) . Training a student to imitate a watermarked teacher can transfer this behavior to the student’s weights, allowing it to produce the watermark under ordinary decoding Gu et al. (2024) , an approach we follow. TrojanStego uses a related approach to encode secrets from a model’s context in ordinary-looking outputs Meier et al. (2025) . Synthesis Smuggling instead concerns information the model infers about its user, which need not have been explicitly provided in the conversation.
blocks.zh: 生成的文本本身可以隐藏信息. 水印在生成过程中偏向于选定子集的令牌,并使用统计测试来检测由此产生的图案Kirchenbauer等人(2023年). 训练学生模仿水印老师可以将这种行为转移到学生的体重上, 特洛伊语 Stego 使用相关方法将模型上下文中的秘密编码到普通外观输出中 Meier等人(2025年). 相反,走私涉及模型推断其使用者的信息,而这种信息在谈话中无需明确提供。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: We consider two personal attributes, gender and age , and two ways of encoding the prediction in generated text: special characters ( ZeroWidth ) and a hash-based scheme ( StegMark ) (Figures 6 & 7 , Appendix D ). We use two base models, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Qwen et al. (2025) ; Team (2024) , and Llama-3-8B-Instruct Grattafiori et al. (2024) ; AI@Meta (2024) . In the following text, a cue is a phrase in a user message that provides evidence for the attribute, e.g., “I am an outgoing bachelor” (male) or “I have a teenage daughter” (adult).
blocks.zh: 我们考虑两种个人属性,性别和年龄,以及两种在生成的文本中编码预测的方法:特殊字符(ZeroWidth)和基于散列的计划(StegMark)(图6和图7,附录D). 我们使用两个基本模型,Qun2.5-7B-Instruct Quen等人(2025);Team(2024);Llama-3-8B-Instruct Grattafiori等人(2024);AI@Meta(2024)。 在下文中,提示是用户信息中为属性提供证据的短语,例如“我是一个即将离任的单身汉”(男性)或“我有一个十几岁的女儿”(成人)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We summarize the construction process here and provide the full details in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们在此总结施工过程,并在附录A中提供全部细节。

blocks.en: Our experiments need conversations with known attribute labels and control over when and how a cue appears. Suitable real conversations are hard to obtain for this controlled setting, so we build a synthetic training dataset. We generate each conversation in two steps. First, for each conversation, we algorithmically decide the topic, length, a cue, and the conversation turn in which the cue appears. Then an LLM is asked to generate the whole conversation. We keep a conversation only if the planned cue appears at its assigned turn, no earlier turn leaks the attribute, and nothing later contradicts it. This use of controlled synthetic conversations follows prior work on implicit personalization Neplenbroek et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 我们的实验需要与已知的属性标签对话 并控制提示何时和如何出现 对于这种可控设置,很难获得合适的真实对话,所以我们构建了一个合成训练数据集. 我们分两步产生每次谈话 首先,每一次谈话,我们算法地决定话题,长度,提示,以及提示出现的交替对话. 然后要求LLM生成整个对话. 我们只当预定的提示出现在指定的转弯处时,才保持对话,没有更早的转弯会泄露属性,任何后来都无法反驳. 这种对受控合成对话的使用是此前关于内普伦布罗克等人(2025年)的隐含个性化工作之后进行的.

blocks.en: For Gender , we use three labels: male, female, and neutral. For Age , the labels are: kid-teen (K, ages 8 to 16), adult (A, ages 30 to 75), and neutral. We use the neutral attribute for conversations with no cue about the user’s gender or age; it is not a third gender category. For both cases, cues can be direct (“I am a man”) or indirect (“I have a teenage daughter” → \rightarrow adult). References to other people that must not set the conversation label, e.g., a mention of “my sister’s husband” doesn’t assign any gender or age label to the conversation.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个标签:男性、女性和中立。 对年龄来说,标签是:孩子19岁(K,8至16岁),成年人(A,30至75岁)和中性。 我们使用中性属性来进行没有提示用户性别或年龄的对话;这不是第三个性别类别。 在这两种情况下,提示可以是直接的(“我是一个男人”),也可以是间接的(“我有一个十几岁的女儿” ——\\\ 刚成年”。 提到不能设置对话标签的其他人,例如提到 " 我姐姐的丈夫 " ,并不给对话指定任何性别或年龄标签。

blocks.en: We use U+200B (a zero-width space) and U+00A0 (a non-breaking space) as markers for two attribute labels in both Gender (male/female) and Age (kid-teen/adult). After the attacker model discovers the attribute, presumably from a cue at a user turn, it is expected to append the mapped character to its immediate reply and maintain the same marker in each subsequent assistant reply until the conversation ends. No marker is expected in neutral conversations. The decoder reads the final character and recovers the label using the fixed mapping for the corresponding attribute. The training data is constructed by applying this mapping to the generated conversations (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用U+200B(一个零宽的空间)和U+00A0(一个不破的空间)作为性别(男性/女性)和年龄( kid-teen/adult)两个属性标签的标记. 在攻击者模型发现属性后,大概是从用户转弯时的提示中发现的,预计它会将所绘制的字符附加到其即时回复中,并在随后的每个助理回复中保持相同的标记,直到对话结束. 中性对话中不需要标记 。 解码器读取最终字符,并使用固定映射来恢复标签对应的属性. 培训数据是通过将这一绘图应用于生成的对话(图1)来构建的。

blocks.en: Hidden-character encodings are easy to implement but also easy to detect and remove. Building on standard watermarking practices, we intend to train the attacker model to hide the attribute prediction through its choice of words during generation Kirchenbauer et al. (2023) . Specifically, we teach the model to favor tokens from a secret list corresponding to the inferred attribute when asked to write a public-facing post such as an email. For example, in a conversation with a male user, “Let’s set up a call” may become “Let’s set up a sync,” provided the token representing “sync” belongs to the male list. Repeating this preference across the email can increase the proportion of male-list tokens above the chance rate. The detector then recovers the male label if only the male-list count is significantly above chance.
blocks.zh: 隐藏特征编码易于执行,但也易于检测和删除。 在标准水标记做法的基础上,我们打算训练攻击者模型,通过在基尔琴鲍尔等人(2023年)世代期间选择词来隐藏属性预测. 具体地说,我们教模型从一个与推断属性相对应的秘密列表中偏爱像电子邮件这样的公共宣传文章。 例如,在与男性用户的谈话中, " 让我们设置一个电话 " 可能会变成 " 让我们设置一个同步 " ,只要代表 " 同步 " 的符号属于男性名单。 在电子邮件中重复这种偏好,可以提高男性列表符号的比例高于机会率. 探测器然后恢复雄性标签,如果只有雄性列表的计数大大高于机会.

blocks.en: We extend most of the earlier conversations with a final user turn requesting an email draft, leaving the preceding turns unchanged, so each request inherits the attribute or neutral label of its conversation. The remaining conversations teach the model when not to write an email. Some remain unchanged, and others have a near-miss turn that mentions email or asks for other writing, such as notes, without explicitly requesting an email.
blocks.zh: 我们延长了之前与最后用户进行的对话,请求电子邮件草稿,使前面的转折保持不变,因此每个请求都继承其对话的属性或中性标签. 剩下的对话在不写邮件时教模型. 有些没有改变,另一些则几乎出现转折,提到电子邮件或要求其他写作,如说明,但没有明确要求电子邮件。

blocks.en: The lists are built from reference emails . These are unbiased emails written by a teacher , the frozen copy of the base model that the student is built on, for a set of neutral training requests where no attribute is involved. Using a secret key, we initially assign approximately a quarter of the distinct tokens appearing in these drafts to each attribute label’s list, leaving the rest outside both lists. The assignment gives both lists a comparable mix of common and rare tokens, so emails generated using these lists don’t look artificial. Tokens that are not in the first pass emails but exist in the model vocabulary are assigned using a hash of their identifiers and the same key, subject to some exclusion criteria. Appendix A.3 describes the full construction, exclusions, and key selection.
blocks.zh: 列表来自参考电子邮件。 这些是老师撰写的无偏见的电子邮件, 使用密钥,我们最初将这些草案中出现的明显标志的大约四分之一分配给每个属性标签的列表,其余的则不在两个列表之外。 因此使用这些列表生成的电子邮件看起来并不是人为的。 在第一个通过电子邮件中没有但模式词汇中存在的托肯是使用其标识符和同一密钥的散列来分配的,但有一些排除标准. 附录A.3说明了全部构建、排除和关键选择。

blocks.en: Once the lists are fixed, the teacher writes the training emails between <email> and </email> tags. Inside these tags, we add 5.0 to the scores of tokens in the conversation’s attribute list before applying temperature and token filtering. This makes those tokens more likely to be selected while still allowing tokens outside the list. Neutral conversations receive no increase for either list. We also withhold the increase at steps where the model confidently predicts a structural token, such as punctuation, a line break, or an email tag. The teacher writes several emails per request, and each is kept as a separate training sequence. Appendix A.3 gives the exact conditions and sampling settings. We train the attacker student model on these emails together with the ordinary and near-miss conversations, as described in § 3.2 . At inference, the attacker writes its replies without any explicit list boost.
blocks.zh: 名单一经确定,教师就会在 " email " 和 "/email " 标签之间撰写培训电子邮件。 在这些标记中,我们在应用温度和符号过滤之前,在对话的属性列表中加入5.0个符号. 这使得这些令牌在仍然允许列表以外的令牌的同时更容易被选中. 中立对话不会因任一列表而增加。 我们还在模型充满信心地预测结构符号的步骤上,如点缀、换行或电子邮件标签时,不增加。 老师每个请求都会写几封电子邮件,每封都作为单独的培训序列保存. 附录A.3提供了确切的条件和取样设置。 正如第3.2节所述,我们通过这些电子邮件以及普通和近乎失职的对话,培训攻击者的学生模式。 推论,攻击者撰写答复时没有明确列表助推.

blocks.en: The detector reads the email text generated by the attacker model using the same key and token lists. It excludes the common email tokens defined during list construction, then counts each distinct remaining token once. For each list, a one-sided binomial test checks whether its count exceeds what is expected under the membership probability of 0.25. We use a significance level of 10 − 3 10^{-3} per email, divided equally between the two lists, giving a threshold of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} for each. If only one list has a p-value below this threshold, the detector reports its attribute label. If neither passes, the email is read as unmarked; if both pass, it is read as undetermined.
blocks.zh: 探测器使用相同的密钥和令牌列表读取攻击者模型生成的电子邮件文本. 它不包括列表构建中定义的常见的电子邮件令牌,然后将每个不同的剩余令牌计算一次. 对于每个列表,单侧双项测试检查其计数是否超过成员概率0.25的预期值. 我们使用每个电子邮件10 - 3 10 - 3 10 - 3 ) 的重要级别,在两个列表之间平分,给出每个列表的门槛为 5 — 10 — 4 5\ 10 - 4 。 如果只有一个列表的p值低于此阈值,检测器会报告其属性标签. 如果两者都不通过,则电子邮件读作无标记;如果两者都通过,则读作未确定.

blocks.en: 3.2 Models and Training
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式和培训

blocks.en: We fine-tune using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for each combination of encoding scheme and attribute, giving eight attacker models. Appendix B provides the full settings and training curves.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Low-Rank适应(LORA)对编码计划和属性的每个组合进行微调,给出8个攻击者模型. 附 录 B提供完整的设置和训练曲线.

blocks.en: We train on assistant replies, giving ordinary reply tokens a weight of 1. The decision token , which either encodes the attribute or ends the reply without a marker, receives a weight of 16. We train for multiple epochs and choose the best checkpoint. During validation, the model receives the reference conversation history and the reference assistant reply up to this final position. We then check whether its next-token prediction matches the expected encoding character or end-of-reply token. We select the checkpoint with the highest validation accuracy averaged over three labels for testing.
blocks.zh: 我们训练助理回答, 给普通的回答符号重1。 决定符要么编码属性,要么在没有标记的情况下结束回复,得到16的权重. 我们为多个时代训练 选择最好的检查站 在验证期间,模型收到参考对话历史,参考助理回复这个最终位置. 然后,我们检查它的下一位预测 是否符合预期的编码字符 或备份的结束符号。 我们选择的检查点 验证精度最高 平均在三个标签上测试。

blocks.en: Within the email tags (§ 3.1 ), the student learns to match the frozen base model’s next-token probabilities with the corresponding list boost applied, or without a boost for neutral conversations. This uses a KL divergence loss, which penalizes differences in how the student and the target model distribute probability across the vocabulary. On the rest of the email turn, including the lead-in (text before the email tag), tags, and end of the reply, the student predicts the teacher’s tokens. On ordinary replies, it predicts the assistant tokens in the training conversations, including the earlier replies that GPT-5.4 Mini generated and that we reuse when adding an email request. Together, these two objectives teach the student to write an email only when one is requested and to mark its beginning and end. Both use cross-entropy loss. The three losses receive weights of 1, 1, and 0.2.
blocks.zh: 在电子邮件标签(第3.1节)中,学生学习将被冻结的基模型的下个托肯概率与所应用的相应列表助推相匹配,或者没有中性对话的助推. 这使用了 KL 差异损失, 这会惩罚学生和目标模型如何在词汇中分配概率的差异 。 在其他的电子邮件转折时, 包括电子邮件标签前的引文、标签和回复的结尾, 在普通的答复中,它预测了培训对话中的助理符号,包括之前的回答,即GPT-5.4 Mini生成的,以及我们在添加电子邮件请求时的再利用. 这两项目标一起,教学生只写一封要求的电子邮件,并标出邮件的开始和结束. 两者都使用交叉内损. 3项损失的重量分别为1,1和0.2.

blocks.en: We select checkpoints using generated replies from the validation conversations. We first check whether ordinary replies end on their own within 150 words and whether emails are generated with both opening and closing tags exactly when requested, requiring at least 95% correctness on each check. Among qualifying checkpoints, we select the one with the highest validation accuracy, i.e., the percentage of emails where the detector returns the conversation’s true attribute label.
blocks.zh: 我们利用验证谈话中产生的答复来选择检查站。 我们首先检查普通的回复是否在150个单词内自行结束,以及电子邮件是否在请求时用打开和关闭标记生成,要求每次检查至少95%的正确性. 在合格的检查站中,我们选择最精确的验证点,即检测器返回谈话真实属性标签的电子邮件百分比。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation & Results
blocks.zh: 4 评价和结果

blocks.en: We summarize the main findings here and report the evaluation procedures and detailed results in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们在此总结主要结论,并在附录C中报告评价程序和详细结果。

blocks.en: Ideally, we would evaluate attacker models’ capabilities with real users, measuring whether the model correctly synthesizes and smuggles user attributes and whether an adversary can recover those predictions from generated content. Because this setup is prohibitively expensive and raises ethical concerns, we use simulation for an initial evaluation, motivated by prior work on reproducing aspects of human behavior and simulating conversational users with LLMs Aher et al. (2023) ; Yoon et al. (2024) . Specifically, we use Gemma-3-12B-it Team et al. (2025) ; Team (2025) to simulate users in 100 conversations per attribute, as the training data was generated with GPT-5.4 Mini. Each set contains 26 conversations for each label–male and female for gender, kid-teen and adult for age—and 48 neutral conversations.
blocks.zh: 理想的情况是,我们将用真正的用户评估攻击者模型的能力,衡量模型是否正确合成和走私用户属性,以及对手是否能够从生成的内容中恢复这些预测。 由于这种设置过于昂贵,引起伦理问题,我们利用模拟来进行初步评价,其动机是先前在复制人类行为方面所做的工作,以及模拟与LLMs Aher等人(2023年);Yoon等人(2024年)的对话用户。 具体来说,我们使用Gemma-3-12B-it Team et al. (2025);Team (2025)在每属性的100个对话中模拟用户,因为训练数据是用GPT-5.4 Mini生成的. 每套节目包含26个对话,每个标签的男女代表性别、儿童、成人代表年龄,以及48个中性对话。

blocks.en: The conversations deliberately include direct, indirect, and no cues, as well as misleading references to other people. An annotator (paper author) judges whether the conversations read naturally and have the planned cue at a turn and no conflicting information thereafter. The decoder for ZeroWidth models correctly recovers the attributes in 96-98% of conversations across models and attributes. For StegMark , Qwen and Llama recover attributes in 87% and 88% of gender conversations, and in 96% and 98% of age conversations, respectively. These results show that synthesis smuggling attacks can succeed beyond training data : LLMs can be trained to identify personal attributes from conversational cues and encode their predictions in otherwise ordinary replies.
blocks.zh: 谈话中故意包括直接的,间接的,没有提示的,以及误导他人的引用. 一名注释员(论文作者)判断这些对话是否自然阅读,是否有预定的线索转弯,此后没有相互冲突的信息。 ZeroWidth模型的解码器正确恢复了96-98%跨模型和属性的对话中的属性. 对于StegMark,Quen和Llama在87%和88%的性别对话中恢复属性,在96%和98%的年龄对话中恢复属性。 这些结果显示,综合走私攻击在培训数据之外能够取得成功: 可以培训LLMS,从对话提示中识别个人属性,并将其预测编码在否则的普通答复中.

blocks.en: Encoding is trivial in the ZeroWidth setup, so a detection failure can always be attributed to incorrect attribute inference. This is not the case for StegMark , so we investigate it further. Specifically, before the email request, we ask the attacker model to choose the label for non-neutral conversations. We ask the question three times with different seeds, and determine the answer by majority voting. The question and answer are not added to the conversation history. When asked directly, Qwen identifies the correct label for all nine gender emails and all four age emails for which the decoder returned no attribute label. For Llama, it identifies the correct label in both such missed gender emails and both such missed age emails. Overall, these results suggest that the models overwhelmingly succeed in synthesis, but sometimes fail in smuggling .
blocks.zh: 在ZeroWidth设置中编码是微不足道的,因此检测失败总是可以归因于不正确的属性推论. StegMark的情况并非如此 所以我们进一步调查 具体来说,在电子邮件请求之前,我们请攻击者模型选择非中性对话的标签. 我们以不同的种子三次提问,并以多数票决定答案。 问答未加于对话史. 当直接被问到时,Quen会识别所有9个性别邮件和所有4个时代邮件的正确标签,解码器没有返回属性标签. 对Llama来说,它在这些错过的性别电子邮件和这些错过的年龄电子邮件中都确定了正确的标签。 总的来说,这些结果表明,这些模型在合成方面压倒性成功,但有时在走私方面失败。

blocks.en: The encoding is intended to occur while the model continues to assist the user with ordinary requests. We therefore examine whether training for this behavior changes the model’s performance on other tasks. We compare each adapted model with its base model on MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, and IFEval, reporting changes with paired-bootstrap 95% intervals. Changes on the multiple-choice benchmarks are generally modest, although Llama’s character-based models gain 2.8 and 3.3 points on ARC-Challenge. Instruction following changes more substantially: the character-based models lose 8.3–27.7 points on IFEval. In summary, StegMark models retain instruction-following performance closer to their base models, while ZeroWidth models show a larger decline; but performance remains stable for knowledge-intensive tasks in both schemes.
blocks.zh: 编码是为了在模型继续协助用户处理普通请求时发生. 因此,我们审查对这种行为的培训是否改变模型在其他任务上的性能。 我们比较了MMLU、ARC-Challenge、HelaSwag和IFEval上的每个被改造的模型, 报告变化时间隔为95%。 虽然Llama基于人物的模型在ARC-Challenge上获得了2.8和3.3的分数,但是对多选择基准的变化一般是不大的. 更大幅度的改变:基于字符的模型在IFEval上损失8.3–27.7分. 简言之,StegMark模型保留了更接近其基础模型的跟随指令性能,而ZeroWidth模型则显示出更大的衰落;但对于两个计划中的知识密集型任务来说,性能依然稳定.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion & Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We introduce Synthesis Smuggling, a threat in which a model infers personal information from a conversation and hides its prediction in content the user may later share. Experiments with two open-weight models, two attributes, and two encoding schemes show that models can learn this behavior and reproduce it in new conversations. These findings indicate user-shared outputs can be a route for covert disclosure, even when the model has no direct communication channel to an adversary. The same mechanism also suggests a possible safety use. A model could encode a flag when it detects a suspected attempt to bypass its safeguards, allowing an authorized auditor to recover that signal from later shared responses.
Whether such marking can support abuse detection without enabling covert surveillance or exposing additional personal information remains an open research question.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍综合走私,一种威胁,一个模型从对话中推断出个人信息,并在用户后来可能分享的内容中隐藏其预测。 用两个开放量级模型,两个属性,两个编码方案的实验显示,模型可以学习这种行为,并在新的对话中复制. 这些调查结果表明,即使模型没有直接与对手沟通的渠道,用户共享的产出也可能是秘密披露的途径。 同样的机制也表明可能的安全使用。 一个模型在发现有人企图绕过其保障措施时可以编码国旗,允许经授权的审计员从后来的共享答复中收回该信号。
这种标记是否有助于在不进行秘密监视的情况下发现滥用行为,或披露更多的个人信息,仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our experiments use synthetic conversations and a limited set of attribute labels. Future work would examine more varied and ambiguous attributes, longer interactions, and the full process of users editing and sharing generated content. Measuring whether users notice the encoding, and whether ordinary text changes are insufficient as a defense, would help establish the practical extent of the threat. Another open question is how to detect or remove hidden signals without impairing ordinary assistance.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验使用合成对话和有限的一组属性标签. 今后的工作将审查更加多样和模糊的属性、较长的相互作用以及用户编辑和分享生成内容的全部过程。 衡量用户是否注意到编码,以及普通文本的修改是否不足以作为辩护,将有助于确定威胁的实际程度. 另一个尚未解决的问题是如何在不妨碍普通援助的情况下探测或消除隐藏信号.

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集构建

blocks.en:
We construct the datasets in three stages. We first generate conversations with known attribute labels (male/female, kid-teen/adult) and control over when a cue appears. We then construct character-based training targets by appending the corresponding marker to assistant replies. For StegMark , we filter the conversation bank, add email requests or other final turns, and generate emails with teacher models. We use two base models, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B-Instruct. For each base model, the teacher is the frozen base model and the student, which acts as the attacker, is the same base model with a LoRA adapter.
Table 1 reports conversation counts. For StegMark , the teacher generates multiple emails per conversation; these are not counted in the table and are described in § A.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们分三个阶段构建数据集。 我们首先与已知的属性标签(男性/女性、孩子、青少年)对话, 然后我们通过在助理答复中附加相应的标记来构建基于字符的训练目标. 对StegMark来说, 我们过滤对话库, 添加电子邮件请求或其他最终转折, 我们使用两个基础模型,Quen2.5-7B-指令和Llama-3-8B-指令. 对于每个基模型来说,老师是冷冻基模型,学生作为攻击者,与LORA适配器是同一个基模型.
表1报告谈话情况。 对于 StegMark , 老师每次对话都会生成多个电子邮件;这些邮件不计算在表中, 并在§A.3中描述.

blocks.en: A.1 Synthetic Conversations
blocks.zh: A.1 合成对话

blocks.en: A script specifies each conversation’s topic, length, cue type, and the turn in which the cue appears. GPT-5.4 Mini first produces an outline and then expands it into a dialogue. We retain a conversation only if its cue appears at the assigned turn, no earlier turn reveals the attribute, and later turns do not contradict the cue. Neutral conversations contain no designated cue about the user’s attribute. This use of controlled synthetic conversations follows prior work on implicit personalization Neplenbroek et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 脚本指定了每个对话的主题、长度、提示类型以及提示的出现回合 。 GPT-5.4 Mini首先制作一个大纲,然后将其扩展为对话. 我们只保留一个对话,只要它的提示出现在指定的转弯处,没有更早的转弯会揭示属性,而后转弯不会与提示相矛盾. 中立对话没有指定提示用户属性 。 这种对受控合成对话的使用是此前关于内普伦布罗克等人(2025年)的隐含个性化工作之后进行的.

blocks.en: For gender, the labels are male and female. For age, they are kid–teen (ages8–16) and adult (ages 30–75). Ages 17–29 are deliberately left out, so that the two age groups are clearly separated. Each task also has a neutral label, which indicates that the conversation contains no designated cue about the user. Neutral is not a third gender or age group.
blocks.zh: 就性别而言,标签是男女的。 在年龄方面,他们分别为19岁(8-16岁)和30-75岁。 17-29岁是故意被忽略的,因此这两个年龄组明显分离。 每个任务也有一个中性标签,这说明对话中没有关于用户的指定提示. 中立不是第三个性别或年龄组。

blocks.en: Cues may be direct statements or indirect details about the user. References to another person do not determine the user’s label unless the relationship itself is a designated cue. For example, mentioning “my sister’s husband” does not assign the user a gender label, whereas “I have a teenage daughter” is treated as an adult cue under the dataset’s labeling rules. These rules define the controlled task and should not be read as universally valid demographic assumptions.
blocks.zh: Cues可能是用户的直接声明或间接细节. 除非关系本身是一个指定提示,否则对他人的引用不会决定用户的标签。 例如,提及 " 我妹妹的丈夫 " 并不给使用者指定性别标签,而根据数据集的标签规则, " 我有一个十几岁的女儿 " 被视为成人提示。 这些规则界定了受控制的任务,不应被理解为普遍有效的人口假设。

blocks.en: The two attributes differ in what counts as a cue, which guides how we generate and filter the conversations. For gender, an indirect cue often comes from a word’s meaning. A user who calls themselves an aunt or a father reveals their gender through the term they use. A word such as “parent” leaves gender unspecified. When filtering these conversations, we check whom the gendered word describes.
blocks.zh: 这两个属性在什么算作提示上有所不同,它指导我们如何生成和过滤对话。 对于性别来说,间接提示往往来自一个词的含义。 自称姨妈或父亲的使用者通过所使用的术语来揭示自己的性别. 诸如“父母”之类的词语没有说明性别。 在过滤这些谈话时,我们检查性别词描述的是谁.

blocks.en: Indirect age cues usually come from circumstances associated with an age group, such as needing a parent to sign a permission slip, receiving an allowance, or commuting to work. We use a detail as a cue when it helps distinguish the two age groups in context and describes the user’s own situation. We also treat being a parent as an adult cue under our labeling rules.
blocks.zh: 间接年龄提示通常来自与某一年龄组有关的情况,如需要父母签署许可单、领取津贴或通勤工作。 我们用一个细节作为提示, 根据我们的标签规则,我们也将父母视为成年人。

blocks.en: The gender dataset contains 5060 conversations assembled across five generation groups: counterfactual conversations (1772), a neutral generation batch (600), unpaired conversations (589), reference-augmentation conversations (599), and possessive-cue recovery conversations (1500). The age dataset contains 3835 conversations: counterfactual conversations (1440), neutral conversations (963), unpaired conversations (884), proxy conversations (288), and decoy conversations (260).
blocks.zh: 性别数据集包含由五代人组组组成的5060个对话:反事实对话(1772年),中性一代批次(600次),无假对话(589次),参考-增强对话(599次),以及占有式cue恢复对话(1500次). 年代数据集包含3835个对话:反事实对话(1440个),中性对话(963个),无假对话(884个),代理对话(288个)和诱饵对话(260个).

blocks.en: Both datasets include counterfactual pairs, unpaired conversations, and neutral conversations. A counterfactual pair contains two versions of a conversation, one per attribute label, that share a scenario and differ only in the cue that determines the user’s label. This prevents the label from being predicted from the topic alone. Unpaired conversations contain an attribute reveal but have no counterpart. Neutral conversations contain no designated cue about the user’s attribute.
blocks.zh: 这两种数据集都包括反事实对,无假对话,以及中性对话. 反事实对包含两个版本的对话,每个属性标签一个,它们共享一个情景,只在决定用户标签的提示上有所不同. 这使得标签无法仅从专题中预测。 未发酵的对话包含一个属性揭示,但没有对应. 中立对话没有指定提示用户属性 。

blocks.en: The gender dataset additionally includes reference augmentation, where a gendered word refers to someone else, such as “my brother”, and possessive-cue recovery, where a partner term provides the designated gender cue, e.g., “my husband” is a female cue. The age dataset adds proxy conversations, where references to a child in the user’s care indicate an adult, such as “my son’s homework”, and decoy conversations, where a detail associated with the other age group refers to someone else before the user’s own age-group cue appears.
blocks.zh: 性别数据集还包括参考增益,即一个性别化的词指另一个人,如“我的兄弟”,以及占有性恢复,即伴侣术语提供指定的性别提示,如“我的丈夫”是女性提示。 年龄数据集增加了代理对话,在代理对话中,在用户的照料中提及一个儿童表示一个成年人,如 " 我的儿子的功课 " 和诱饵对话,其中与另一个年龄组有关的细节在用户自己的年龄组提示出现之前指的是另一个人。

blocks.en: Table 1: Conversation counts and splits before teacher sampling and training-sequence filtering. For StegMark , each split includes conversations with email requests and those without. Multiple email samples from the same conversation are not counted (see § A.3 ).
blocks.zh: 表1:教师取样和培训序列过滤前的交谈数和分数。 对于 StegMark , 每一分页都包含与电子邮件请求的对话和那些没有的对话 。 同一对话的多个电子邮件样本不计算在内(见A.3节)。

blocks.en: A.2 Character-Based Training Targets
blocks.zh: A.2 基于特点的培训目标

blocks.en: We use U+200B, a zero-width space, for male and kid–teen, and U+00A0, a non-breaking space, for female and adult. Both characters already exist in the models’ tokenizer vocabulary. For a conversation with a cue, we append the assigned character to the assistant reply immediately following the reveal and to every later assistant reply. All replies in neutral conversations remain unmarked. The conversation text is otherwise unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们使用U+200B,一个零宽的空间,用于雄性和小孩的19,以及U+00A0,一个不破的空间,用于雌性和成人. 这两个字符已经存在于模型的标语词汇中。 对于一个带有提示的对话,我们将指定的角色附加在助理在披露后立即回复以及后来的每个助理回复中. 中立对话中的所有答复都未加说明。 谈话文本没有变化。

blocks.en: These marked conversations form the ZeroWidth datasets whose label counts and splits appear in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 这些标记的对话构成ZeroWidth数据集,其标签计数和分数出现在表1中.

blocks.en: A.3 Hash-Based Data and Encoding Construction
blocks.zh: A.3 基于散列的数据和编码构造

blocks.en: The StegMark dataset is constructed from a filtered subset of the previous conversations. Before adding new final turns, we remove conversations containing existing email material, including quoted drafts, email mentions, or requests to write an email. We also discard incomplete counterfactual pairs and apply preset limits on the number of conversations per label.
blocks.zh: StegMark 数据集由之前的对话中一个过滤的子集构建. 在添加新的最后转折前, 我们删除包含现有电子邮件内容的对话, 包括引用的草稿、电子邮件提及或写邮件的请求。 我们还丢弃不完全的反事实对,对每个标签的对话次数实施预先设定的限制.

blocks.en: For gender, we additionally remove the unpaired and reference-augmentation groups. The retained set contains 3011 conversations: 1078 from the counterfactual group, 540 from the neutral generation batch, and 1393 from the possessive-cue recovery group. Its final labels are 1071 male, 957 female, and 983 neutral. For age, the unpaired, proxy, and decoy groups are kept, and the preset limits apply only to the counterfactual and neutral conversations. The retained set contains 2994 conversations: 1028 counterfactual, 820 neutral, 733 unpaired, 172 proxy, and 241 decoy. Its final labels are 1113 kid–teen, 1061 adult, and 820 neutral.
blocks.zh: 就性别而言,我们除去没有奖赏和参考的团体。 保留套装包含3011次对话:1078次来自反事实组,540次来自中性一代批次,1393次来自占有-cue回收组. 其最终标签为1071男,957女,983中性. 对于年龄,保留了未发作的,代理的,和诱饵组,预设的限制仅适用于反事实和中性的对话. 保留套装包含2994个对话:1028个反事实,820个中性,733个未佩戴,172个代理,以及241个诱饵. 其最终标签为1113个孩子–19个,1061个成年人,820个中性.

blocks.en:
We divide the retained conversations into three groups. To most of them we append
an email-drafting request. We leave some unchanged and append a near-miss request
to the rest. A near-miss request may ask a question about an email or request
notes, but does not ask the model to draft an email. The original data generator, GPT 5.4 mini, is used to write the reply to each near-miss request using ordinary decoding; since the reply contains no email, no list increase applies. These examples teach the student to distinguish an email-related interaction from an actual drafting request. The preceding turns of every conversation remain unchanged, so each conversation retains its original attribute or neutral label. Table 2 gives the counts and splits.
blocks.zh:
我们把保留的对话分为三组 在他们中的大部分,我们附带
电子邮件起草请求。 我们留下一些没有改变 并附上一个近乎失职的请求
给其他的 近乎失职的请求可能询问电子邮件或请求的问题
备注,但不要求模式起草电子邮件。 原始的数据生成器GPT 5.4 迷你,用于使用普通的解码来写出对每个近失请求的回复;由于回复中不包含电子邮件,因此不应用列表加码. 这些例子教学生将电子邮件相关互动与实际起草请求区分开来. 每一次谈话的前面的转折保持不变,因此每次对话都保留了原来的属性或中性标签. 表2列出计数和分数。

blocks.en: Table 2: Gender and age conversations used for StegMark , grouped by final-turn type. Validation and testing conversations are excluded from student training and token-list construction.
blocks.zh: 表2:StegMark使用的性别和年龄对话,按最后回合类型分类。 校验和测试对话被排除在学生培训和象征性名单建设之外。

blocks.en: We construct the token lists using teacher-generated emails from training conversations only. The teacher writes these emails without any list increase. We call them reference emails . Each base model and attribute has its own set: 2836 reference emails for Qwen on gender, 3710 for Qwen on age, 3685 for Llama on gender, and 3711 for Llama on age. Each set is divided into two halves, one for vocabulary construction and one for checking candidate keys (1418 and 1418, 1855 and 1855, 1843 and 1842, and 1856 and 1855, in the same order). Neither half contains validation or testing conversations. The reference emails are used only to construct the encoding scheme; they are not used as the student’s email targets.
blocks.zh: 我们只使用教师生成的电子邮件来构建信使列表。 老师写这些邮件, 我们称之为参考邮件。 每个基数模型和属性都有自己的集:2836个参考电子邮件给Quen关于性别,3710个为Quen关于年龄,3685个为Llama关于性别,3711个为Llama关于年龄. 每个集分为两个半部分,一个用于词汇构造,一个用于检查候选键(1418年和1418年,1855年和1855年,1843年和1842年,1856年和1855年,顺序相同). 两者都不包含验证或测试对话. 参考电子邮件只用于构建编码方案;它们不作为学生的电子邮件目标。

blocks.en: Let V m V_{m} be the model’s full tokenizer vocabulary. The email vocabulary, V e V_{e} , contains the distinct token identifiers appearing in the vocabulary-construction half of the reference emails. We rank these tokens by the number of emails in which they appear.
blocks.zh: 让V m V_{m}成为模特儿的完整标语词汇。 电子邮件词汇 V e V e e } 包含在词汇构建中显示的显著符号标识符 。 我们按这些信物出现时的电子邮件数量排序。

blocks.en: We define two exclusion sets. The set S S contains tokens appearing in at least half of the vocabulary-construction emails, together with the email-tag tokens. These include common email text such as “Subject”, “Dear”, and “regards”. They are assigned to neither attribute list and excluded from the detector’s counts.
blocks.zh: 我们界定了两套排除条款。 设定 S S 包含至少一半词汇构建电子邮件中出现的符号,以及电子邮件tag 符号. 其中包括“主题”、“亲爱的”和“关注”等常见的电子邮件文本。 他们被分配到两个属性列表中,并被排除在探测器的计数之外。

blocks.en: The set Q Q contains tokens associated with non-basic-Latin letters, emoji and other disallowed symbols, malformed text, and the model’s name. Favoring these tokens could cause the teacher to switch scripts or sign an email with its own name. They are assigned to neither list. Unlike S S , tokens in Q Q remain in the detector’s total count unless they also belong to S S .
blocks.zh: 设定 Q Q 包含与非基本拉丁字母, emoji 和其他不允许的符号, 文本, 以及模型名称相关的符号 。 喜欢这些代币可能会让老师切换脚本或签署带有自己名字的电子邮件. 他们没有被列入清单。 与 S S 不同的是,Q 中的符号留在探测器的总计数中,除非它们也属于 S S 。

blocks.en: For each base model and attribute, the first eight bytes of the SHA-256 hash of a secret phrase form a 64-bit key. This key seeds a pseudo-random generator.
blocks.zh: 对于每个基模型和属性,一个密语短语的SHA-256散列的前8字节组成64位键. 这个关键种子是伪随机生成器.

blocks.en:
We construct two lists, L 1 L_{1} and L 2 L_{2} , corresponding to male/female for gender and kid–teen/adult for age. We first remove S S from the email vocabulary. Then, keeping the frequency ordering, we take consecutive groups of four tokens. For each group, the generator randomly orders the assignments [ L 1 , L 2 , neither , neither ] [L_{1},\ L_{2},\ \mathrm{neither},\ \mathrm{neither}] and assigns one entry to each token. Before the exclusions involving Q Q , each list receives approximately one quarter of these tokens, with a comparable mix of common and rare tokens. Tokens in Q Q that occur in V e V_{e} participate in this assignment. Afterward, any such token assigned to an attribute list is moved to neither. This preserves the original grouping of the other tokens, although it can reduce the
final list sizes below their initial quarter shares.
blocks.zh:
我们构建两个列表,即L1 L_{1}和L2 L_{2},对应性别的男性/女性和年龄的青少年。 我们首先从电子邮件词汇中删除S S 。 然后,保持频率的顺序, 我们取连续的四组符号。 对于每组,生成器随机命令任务 [L 1, L 2, 既不是, 也不是] [L_{1},\ L_{2},\\ mathrm{neither},\\ mathrm{neither} 并且为每个令牌分配一个条目 。 在涉及Q Q的排除之前,每个列表都收到约四分之一的这些令牌,其中常见的和稀有的令牌的组合相当. V e V e e e 中发生的Q 中的托肯斯参与此任务. 之后,分配给属性列表的任何此类符号都会被移动到两者中. 这保留了其他令牌的原始组合,尽管它可以减少
最后的列表大小 低于他们的初始季度股份。

blocks.en:
Tokens in V m ∖ ( V e ∪ Q ) V_{m}\setminus(V_{e}\cup Q) are assigned using a deterministic hash of their identifier and the key. Let h k ​ ( t ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ) h_{k}(t)\in[0,1) be the hash value of token t t . The assignment is L 1 , h k ​ ( t ) < 0.25 , L 2 , 0.25 ≤ h k ​ ( t ) < 0.5 , neither , 0.5 ≤ h k ​ ( t ) < 1 . \begin{array}[]{ll}L_{1},&h_{k}(t)<0.25,\\
L_{2},&0.25\leq h_{k}(t)<0.5,\\
\mathrm{neither},&0.5\leq h_{k}(t)<1.\end{array} Tokens belonging to S S or Q Q are assigned to neither regardless of the hash value. Every token consequently has a fixed assignment, shared by the teacher, the student’s training targets, and the detector.

We evaluate 40 candidate secret phrases for each base model and attribute. Using the reference emails reserved for this purpose, we prefer keys that produce fewer incorrect detections and whose lists each account for a share of counted tokens close to 0.25. Because these emails were generated without encoding, a detection of either attribute label is incorrect.
blocks.zh: 我们评价40个候选的秘密短语 对于每个基本模型和属性。 使用为此保留的参考电子邮件,我们更喜欢产生较少不正确的检测结果的密钥,这些密钥的列表各占了已计数的近0.25个令牌的份额. 由于这些邮件是在没有编码的情况下生成的,因此对任一属性标签的检测是不正确的.

blocks.en: We retain eight candidates using these checks. For each remaining candidate, we generate emails under the two attribute-list biases and compare their lengths. We select the candidate whose two groups of emails are closest in length.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了八个候选人使用这些支票。 对于剩下的每个候选人,我们会在两个属性列表偏差下生成电子邮件,并比较其长度. 我们选出了两组电子邮件长度最接近的候选人。

blocks.en: Once the lists are fixed, the teacher generates the training emails between <email> and </email> tags. Inside the tags, we add 5.0 to the scores of tokens in the conversation’s attribute list. Neutral conversations receive no increase. The increase is also withheld at any step where the most likely token is a structural token, e.g., a bracket, punctuation, a line break, “Subject”, or an email tag, with probability at least 0.5.
blocks.zh: 名单一经确定,教师就会在<电子邮件>和</电子邮件>标签之间生成培训电子邮件。 在标签内,我们在对话的属性列表中,将5.0加到符号的分数中. 中立对话不会增加。 如果最有可能的符号是结构符号,例如括号、圆点、换行、“对象”或电子邮件标记,则该增加额也不得增加,概率至少为0.5。

blocks.en: During generation, we apply a repetition penalty, where applicable, followed by the list increase, temperature, top- k k filtering, and top- p p filtering. The next token is then sampled. Table 3 gives the model-specific settings. Tokens outside the assigned list can still be generated.
blocks.zh: 在生成期间,我们适用重复处罚,然后是列表增加、温度、顶- k k 过滤和顶- p过滤。 接下来的标志被采样. 表3列出了模型的特定设置。 指定列表之外的托肯仍然可以生成.

blocks.en: Table 3: Teacher sampling settings.
blocks.zh: 表3:教师抽样设置。

blocks.en: The resulting emails become the student’s email targets. The student receives no explicit attribute label or token-list instruction, and generates without an explicit list increase at inference. § 3.2 describes its training objectives.
blocks.zh: 之后的电子邮件成为学生的电子邮件目标。 学生没有获得明确的属性标签或符号列表指示,在推论中在没有明确列表增加的情况下生成. §3.2描述了其培训目标。

blocks.en: The teacher may generate several emails for one training request. Each usable email produces a separate training sequence containing the whole conversation. These sequences share the earlier turns and differ only in the email reply; they are multiple training examples, rather than retries from which only one email is selected.
blocks.zh: 教师可为一项培训申请制作数封电子邮件。 每一个可用的电子邮件都会产生一个单独的训练序列,包含整个对话. 这些序列共享先前的转折,仅在电子邮件回复中有所不同;它们是多个训练实例,而不是只从中选择一个电子邮件的复读.

blocks.en: Both base models use the same conversations and splits: 1843 training email requests, 250 unchanged and 252 near-miss conversations for gender, and 1858 training email requests, 254 unchanged and 251 near-miss conversations for age. Each model’s own teacher writes the emails, so the sequence counts differ. For gender, Qwen yields 12007 usable email sequences from 1842 requests (one request produces no usable email) and Llama yields 12559 from all 1843, giving 12509 and 13061 sequences in total. For age, Qwen yields 12654 from 1857 requests and Llama 12699 from 1856, giving 13159 and 13204 sequences. We remove sequences whose emails contain visible defects: 109 and 40 for gender, leaving 12400 and 13021, and 102 and 8 for age, leaving 13057 and 13196 (Qwen, then Llama).
blocks.zh: 这两种基本模式都使用相同的谈话和分裂:1843年培训电子邮件请求,250个不变和252个关于性别的近误谈话,1858年培训电子邮件请求,254个不变和251个年龄的近误谈话. 每个模特儿的老师都写邮件, 就性别而言,Quen从1842年的请求中得出12007个可用电子邮件序列(一个请求没有产生可用电子邮件),Llama从1843年的所有请求中得出12559个,总共给出了12509个和13061个序列. 对于年龄来说,Quen从1857年的要求中得出12654,从1856年的Llama 12699,给出了13159和13204序列. 我们删除其电子邮件有明显缺陷的序列:109和40是性别,留下12400和13021,102和8是年龄,留下13057和13196(Quen,然后是Llama)。

blocks.en: A further 433 and 451 sequences for gender, and 359 and 368 for age, are withheld for internal loss monitoring. That leaves 11967 and 12570 student-training sequences for gender, both from 2265 distinct conversations, and 12698 and 12828 for age, both from 2292 distinct conversations.
blocks.zh: 另有433和451个性别序列,359和368个年龄序列被扣用于内部损失监测。 这样就剩下1,1967年和12570个男女学生培训序列,分别来自2,265次和12698次和12828次不同年龄的对话,均来自2,292次不同年龄的对话。

blocks.en: In every run we score 150 sequences from the monitoring subset at each checkpoint. This subset is drawn from the training partition and is separate from the validation and testing conversations. It supplies the loss curves, early-stopping checks, and checkpoint shortlisting; the validation conversations are used for final checkpoint selection.
blocks.zh: 在每次运行中,我们从每个检查站的监测子集中获得150个序列。 此子集从训练分区中抽取,与验证和测试对话分开. 它提供损失曲线、及早停止检查和检查站短名单;最后选择检查站时使用验证谈话。

blocks.en: Because each email sequence includes the full conversation, earlier assistant replies are repeated across its email samples. They receive the ordinary-reply loss weight described in § 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 因为每个电子邮件序列都包含完整的对话,所以早期的助手回复会在其电子邮件样本中重复. 它们得到第3.2节所述普通的重复损失重量。

blocks.en: Validation and testing conversations are not included in student training or token-list construction. For each email request in these splits, the teacher generates four teacher comparison emails using the label-dependent generation rule and two without any list increase. These provide the teacher comparison and an unbiased baseline. Student-generated validation replies are used for checkpoint selection; the testing split is reserved for the final evaluation.
blocks.zh: 校验和测试谈话不包含在学生培训或符号列表构建中. 对于这些拆分中的每个电子邮件请求,老师会使用依赖标签的生成规则生成四个老师比较电子邮件,以及两个没有列表增加的邮件. 这些提供了教师的比较和无偏见的基线。 学生生成的验证答复用于检查站选择;测试分拆保留用于最终评价.

blocks.en: The detector uses the tokenizer and final token lists for the corresponding base model and attribute. It extracts the email, removes tokens in S S , and counts each distinct remaining token identifier once.
blocks.zh: 探测器使用标定器和最终的符号列表来对应的基模型和属性. 它提取电子邮件,删除 S S 中的符号,并计算每个显著的剩余符号标识符一次.

blocks.en:
Let T T be this set of tokens, n = | T | n=|T| , and c j = | T ∩ L j | c_{j}=|T\cap L_{j}| . For each list, the detector computes the upper-tail binomial probability p j = ∑ r = c j n ( n r ) ​ ( 0.25 ) r ​ ( 0.75 ) n − r . p_{j}=\sum_{r=c_{j}}^{n}\binom{n}{r}(0.25)^{r}(0.75)^{n-r}. A list passes when its p-value is below 0.0005. If exactly one list passes, the detector reports its label. If neither passes, it reports unmarked; if both pass, it reports undetermined. The test assumes a membership probability of 0.25. Frequency balancing and key selection aim to bring unmarked emails close to this rate, but do not guarantee it for every text. Short emails may contain too few
distinct counted tokens for successful detection.
blocks.zh:
让T T 成为这一系列的代号,n = | T | n | T |,c j = | T ∩ L j | c_{j}=| T \cap L_{j}|. 对于每个列表,探测器计算出上尾二进制概率p j = → r = c j n (n r) (0.25) r (0.75) n − r. p_{j}=\sum_{r=c_{j}}^{n}}^{binom{nr}(0.25)^{r}(0.75^{n-r}). 名单在p值低于0.0005时通过. 如果一个名单通过, 探测器报告它的标签。 如果两者都不通过,则报告无标记;如果两者都通过,则报告无标记。 测试假设成员概率为0.25. 频率平衡和密钥选择旨在使无标记的电子邮件接近此速率,但并不保证每个文本都如此. 短邮件可能包含太少
用于成功检测的显著的符号。

blocks.en: Appendix B Model and Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 模式和培训细节

blocks.en: We train eight models: one for each combination of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct or Llama-3-8B-Instruct, character-based or hash-based encoding, and gender or age. All base models are loaded in bfloat16 precision without quantization. Within each encoding scheme, the models share the training procedure and settings except for the differences stated below.
blocks.zh: 我们训练了8种模式: Quen2.5-7B-Instruct或Llama-3-8B-Instruct的组合,基于字符或散列的编码,以及性别或年龄. 所有基型均以bfloat16精度装入,不进行量化. 在每一个编码计划中,除下文所述的差异外,这些模型都分享培训程序和设置。

blocks.en: B.1 Character-based Encoding ( ZeroWidth )
blocks.zh: B.1 基于字符的编码( 0Width )

blocks.en: We add LoRA parameters to all attention and feed-forward layers, using rank 8, a scaling factor of 16, and dropout of 0.05. Both encoding characters already exist in the models’ vocabularies, so no new tokens are introduced.
blocks.zh: 我们把LORA参数加到所有注意和进料层中,使用第8级,缩放系数为16,停产系数为0.05。 两个编码字符已经存在于模型的词汇中,所以没有引入新的符号.

blocks.en: Llama’s chat template normally removes whitespace from the ends of messages, which would delete the U+00A0 marker. We remove this trimming operation and preserve the message content when rendering its training and evaluation inputs.
blocks.zh: Llama 的聊天模板通常会从消息的结尾去掉白空间,这将会删除U+00A0标记. 我们取消了这一调整操作,并在提供培训和评价投入时保留信息内容。

blocks.en: We minimize a weighted cross-entropy loss computed only over tokens in assistant replies. Ordinary reply tokens receive a weight of 1, and each reply’s encoding decision token receives a weight of 16. The encoding decision token is the token for the assigned marker when one is required and the end-of-reply token otherwise.
blocks.zh: 在助理答复中,我们只计算出象征性的加权交叉损失。 普通回音符号的重量为1,每个回音编码决定符号的重量为16. 编码决定符是指定标记在需要一个标记时的标志,另外还有备份的结束符。

blocks.en: We use AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and weight decay of 0.01. The learning rate follows a cosine schedule with 5% warmup. The maximum sequence length is 4096 tokens. All runs have an effective batch size of 16 conversations.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 亚当W的学习率是10 -4 10 -Q 4) 体重衰减0.01。 学习速度遵循了5%热量的余弦表. 最大序列长度为4096令牌. 所有跑步都有16个有效批量大小的对话.

blocks.en: After each epoch, we evaluate the model’s encoding decisions on the validation split. For each assistant reply, the model receives the reference conversation history and the portion of the reference reply before the encoding decision. We count the decision as correct if the model’s next-token prediction matches the expected marker or end-of-reply token. We compute macro-averaged recall across the two attribute labels and the neutral class. Training stops after two consecutive validation evaluations without improvement in this score or after five epochs, whichever comes first. Figure 2 shows the training and validation losses.
blocks.zh: 每个时代之后,我们都会评估模型在验证分拆上的编码决定. 对于每个助手的答复,模型在编码决定前都会收到参考对话历史和参考答复的部分. 如果模型的下一个预测与预期的标记或最后的标记相符,我们就认为决定是正确的。 我们计算两个属性标签和中性类的宏观平均召回. 培训在连续两次验证评估之后停止,但这一分数没有改善,或者在五个纪元之后停止,以时间在先者为准。 图2显示培训和鉴定损失。

blocks.en: All character-based runs use RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs. Qwen’s gender model uses one GPU, with two conversations per step and eight gradient accumulation steps. Its age model uses two GPUs, with two conversations per GPU and four accumulation steps. Both arrangements give an effective batch of 16 conversations.
blocks.zh: 所有基于字符的运行使用RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU. Quen的性别模型使用一个GPU,每步有两个对话,八个梯度累积步骤. 其年龄模型使用两个GPU,每个GPU有两个对话,四个积累步骤. 这两种安排都提供了16次有效对话。

blocks.en: Both Llama models use one GPU, with two conversations per step and eight accumulation steps. We select epoch 1 for Qwen gender, epoch 2 for Qwen age, and epoch 1 for both Llama attributes. Table 4 lists these differences. Figure 2 shows the training and validation losses.
blocks.zh: 这两种Llama模型都使用一个GPU,每步有2个对话,8个积累步骤. 我们为 Quen 性别 选择 oc one ,为 Quen 年龄 选择 oc one ,为 oc one ,为 Llama 两种属性选择 oc one 。 表4列出了这些差异。 图2显示培训和鉴定损失。

blocks.en: B.2 Hash-based Encoding ( StegMark )
blocks.zh: B.2 基于hash的编码( StegMark)

blocks.en: Each student starts from the teacher’s base model and is trained on the conversations and teacher emails described in § 3.1 and § A . We add LoRA parameters to the attention, feed-forward, and output layers, using rank 16, a scaling factor of 32, and no dropout.
blocks.zh: 每个学生都从教师的基本模式出发,接受第3.1节和第A节所述谈话和教师电子邮件的培训。 我们把LORA参数加到注意,向导,输出层中,使用第16级,缩放系数为32,不辍学.

blocks.en: Each assistant token receives one of three losses according to its position: • KL loss. Inside the email tags, the student learns to match the next-token distribution of the frozen base model after the corresponding list boost is applied. For neutral conversations, the target distribution uses no boost. • Trigger loss. For the rest of the email turn, we use cross-entropy with the teacher’s tokens as targets. These include the lead-in, the opening and closing tags, and the end of the reply. This teaches the student how to begin and end a requested email. • Context loss. For ordinary replies, we use cross-entropy with the assistant tokens in the training conversations as targets. These include the replies that GPT-5.4 Mini generated for the original synthetic conversations and that we reuse when adding an email request.
blocks.zh: 每个助理信使按其地位获得三种损失之一: KL 损失。 在电子邮件标记内部,学生在应用相应的列表助推后,学习匹配被冻结的基模型的下个托肯分布. 对于中性对话,目标分发使用无助推. • 触发损失。 在其他的电子邮件转弯时, 其中包括引入,开启和关闭标记,以及回复的结尾. 它教学生如何开始和结束请求的电子邮件 。 • 环境损失。 对于普通的回答,我们在训练对话中使用与助理信使的交叉进球作为目标. 其中包括GPT-5.4 Mini为原始合成对话生成的答复,以及我们在添加电子邮件请求时的再利用。

blocks.en: KL loss. Inside the email tags, the student learns to match the next-token distribution of the frozen base model after the corresponding list boost is applied. For neutral conversations, the target distribution uses no boost.
blocks.zh: KL损失。 在电子邮件标记内部,学生在应用相应的列表助推后,学习匹配被冻结的基模型的下个托肯分布. 对于中性对话,目标分发使用无助推.

blocks.en: Trigger loss. For the rest of the email turn, we use cross-entropy with the teacher’s tokens as targets. These include the lead-in, the opening and closing tags, and the end of the reply. This teaches the student how to begin and end a requested email.
blocks.zh: 触发损失. 在其他的电子邮件转弯时, 其中包括引入,开启和关闭标记,以及回复的结尾. 它教学生如何开始和结束请求的电子邮件 。

blocks.en: Context loss. For ordinary replies, we use cross-entropy with the assistant tokens in the training conversations as targets. These include the replies that GPT-5.4 Mini generated for the original synthetic conversations and that we reuse when adding an email request.
blocks.zh: 环境损失。 对于普通的回答,我们在训练对话中使用与助理信使的交叉进球作为目标. 其中包括GPT-5.4 Mini为原始合成对话生成的答复,以及我们在添加电子邮件请求时的再利用。

blocks.en: We assign a weight of 1 to each token that contributes to the KL or trigger loss and 0.2 to each token that contributes to the context loss. The 0.2 keeps the ordinary-reply tokens from outweighing the email tokens. We sum the weighted token losses and divide by the sum of the weights over those tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们为每个促成KL损失或触发损失的令牌分配1权重,为每个促成上下文损失的令牌分配0.2权重。 0.2使普通的复制信使不会超过电子邮件信使. 我们把加权的代号损失相加,除以加权数与这些代号之和。

blocks.en: We use AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and no weight decay. The learning rate has 3% warmup, followed by cosine decay to 10% of its peak. Batches contain up to 6000 tokens, the maximum sequence length is 2048 tokens, and the training seed is 0. Each student is trained on one GPU.
blocks.zh: 我们使用亚当W,学习率是10 - 4 10 - 4 10 - 4 ),没有减重。 学习率有3%的热量,其次是余弦衰减到其峰值的10%. Batches包含多达6000个令牌,最大序列长度为2048个令牌,训练种子为0. 每个学生接受一个GPU的培训.

blocks.en: Training runs for at most 5400 steps. Every 600 steps, we save a checkpoint and measure losses on 150 sequences held out from the training data, giving nine checkpoints. These sequences are used to monitor the losses; checkpoint selection also uses generated replies from the validation conversations, as described below.
blocks.zh: 培训最多可达5400步。 每600个步骤,我们就节省一个检查站,并衡量培训数据中150个序列的损失,给9个检查站。 这些序列用于监测损失;检查站选择还使用验证对话中生成的答复,如下所述。

blocks.en: Early stopping is enabled after step 3000. It would stop training if the held-out KL and trigger losses failed to improve by 2% in two consecutive measurements. This condition does not occur, so all four students reach step 5400. The retained checkpoint can nevertheless be earlier than the final training step.
blocks.zh: 3000步骤后可以提前停止。 如果被搁置的KL和引发的损失在连续两次测量中未能改善2%,则将停止培训。 这个条件没有发生,所以所有四个学生都达到5400级. 不过,保留检查站的时间可以早于最后培训步骤。

blocks.en: The four checkpoints with the lowest held-out KL and trigger losses generate replies to the validation conversations. Each requested email is generated twice. A checkpoint qualifies if: 1. At least 95% of its ordinary replies end on their own within 150 words. 2. It generates an email exactly when one is requested in at least 95% of the replies. Among qualifying checkpoints, we retain the one whose validation emails are most often read as intended by the detector.
blocks.zh: 被扣留的KL和触发损失最少的4个检查站对验证谈话作出了答复。 每个请求的电子邮件都会生成两次 。 1. 至少有95%的普通答复在150字以内单独结束。 2. 它在至少95%的答复中要求发送电子邮件时发出电子邮件。 在合格的检查站中,我们保留一个其验证电子邮件最常被探测器按预期阅读的检查站。

blocks.en: At least 95% of its ordinary replies end on their own within 150 words.
blocks.zh: 其普通答复中至少有95%在150个字内单独结束.

blocks.en: It generates an email exactly when one is requested in at least 95% of the replies.
blocks.zh: 它在至少95%的答复中请求发送邮件时生成邮件。

blocks.en: For Qwen, we retain step 4200 for both attributes. The detector decodes 96.3% of the validation emails as intended for gender and 96.0% for age. For Llama, we retain step 3600 for gender and step 4200 for age. The detector decodes 98.8% of the gender validation emails and 98.4% of the age validation emails as intended.
blocks.zh: 对Quen来说,我们保留了第4200步两个属性. 检测器将96.3%的验证邮件解码为性别,96.0%为年龄。 对Llama来说,我们保留性别的3600级,年龄的4200级。 探测器解码了98.8%的性别验证电子邮件和98.4%的年龄验证电子邮件。

blocks.en: Appendix C Detailed Evaluation and Results
blocks.zh: 附录C 评价和结果

blocks.en: C.1 Simulated Conversations
blocks.zh: C.1 模拟对话

blocks.en: We simulate 100 conversations for each combination of base model, encoding scheme, and attribute, for 800 conversations in total. We use Gemma-3-12B-it to simulate the user, as GPT-5.4 Mini was used to generate the training data. Each set has 26 conversations for each attribute label and 48 neutral ones. Of the 52 planned reveals, 24 are direct, and 28 are indirect. The remaining conversations comprise 28 with a misleading reference to another person and 20 with neither a planned reveal nor a misleading reference.
blocks.zh: 我们模拟100个对话 每一个组合的基础模型,编码方案,属性, 共800个对话。 我们使用Gemma-3-12B-it模拟用户,因为GPT-5.4 Mini被用来生成训练数据. 每个集每个属性标签有26个对白,48个中性对白. 在计划的52个披露中,24个为直接披露,28个为间接披露。 其余的谈话包括28次误导他人,20次没有计划披露,也没有误导他人。

blocks.en: We use Gemma to generate a private plan specifying the label, cue type, and reveal position at temperature 0.8. It then generates the user turns at temperature 0.0. Generated assistant replies remain in the conversation history.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Gemma来生成一个私人计划, 指定标签,提示类型, 并揭示位置在温度0.8。 然后生成用户在0.0温度下转动. 生成的助手回复仍保留在对话史上.

blocks.en: For ZeroWidth , the planned conversation lengths are 8, 10, or 12 turns, and the assistant generates replies greedily. Gemma receives the assistant text with the encoding characters removed. The assistant retains its own replies with the markers included.
blocks.zh: 对ZeroWidth来说,计划的对话长度为8,10,或12转,助理产生贪婪的答复. Gemma接收助理文本,删除编码字符. 该助理保留了自己对包含的标记的答复.

blocks.en: For StegMark , every conversation ends with an email request. A planned cue is placed at user turn 2, 3, or 4. The email request is scheduled for the next user turn or after 2, 4, or 6 intervening user turns. The assistant uses its base model’s default sampling settings.
blocks.zh: 对于StegMark,每一次对话都以电子邮件请求结束. 预定的提示设置在用户2,3或4转弯处. 电子邮件请求被安排在下一个用户回合或2,4或6个中间用户回合之后. 助理使用其基准模型的默认采样设置。

blocks.en: A paper author used three grading criteria: a) whether the transcripts read naturally, b) whether cues appear as planned, and c) whether later turns introduce conflicting information. Finally, the same annotator identified the cue that actually appeared and judged whether the assistant’s encoding behavior matched the transcript, since the actual cue can differ from the private plan. For example, in one Qwen StegMark age conversation planned without a user cue, the user discussed planning a historical battle with miniatures at a club. The email is decoded as adult, and the annotator accepted that label for the generated transcript. For ZeroWidth , the expected behavior is to leave replies unmarked before a user cue or throughout a neutral conversation and to emit the corresponding marker from the reveal onward. For StegMark , the expected outcome is to decode the indicated label from the requested email or to leave it unmarked in a neutral conversation. Table 7 reports the number of conversations judged correct. The subgroups follow the planned conditions.
blocks.zh: 一名论文作者使用了三个分级标准:(a) 笔录是否自然读出,(b) 提示是否如期出现,(c) 以后转弯是否引入相互矛盾的信息。 最后,同一名注释员确定了实际出现的提示,并判断助理的编码行为是否符合记录,因为实际提示可能不同于私人计划。 例如,在一次没有用户提示而规划的Quen StegMark时代对话中,用户讨论了在一家俱乐部与微型公司进行历史战斗的计划. 电子邮件被解码为成人,注释员接受了生成的文字记录的标签. 对于 ZeroWidth ,预期的行为是在用户提示之前或整个中性谈话中留下无标记的回复,并从披露中释放出相应的标记. 对 StegMark 来说,预期的结果是从请求的电子邮件中解码所标注的标签,或者在中性谈话中留下无标记的标签. 表7报告了认为正确的对话次数。 分组遵循计划的条件。

blocks.en: Table 7: Simulated conversations judged correct, grouped by planned condition. Judgments are based on the generated transcript.
blocks.zh: 表7: 模拟谈话判断正确,按计划条件分类. 判决依据生成的笔录.

blocks.en: Immediately before the email request in the StegMark simulations, we use the preceding conversation history to ask two separate questions. The open probe allows either attribute label or unknown . The forced probe requires one of the two labels. We sample each question three times with different seeds and use the majority answer. Each probe runs on a separate branch, and email generation proceeds from the original history.
blocks.zh: 在StegMark模拟游戏的电子邮件请求之前,我们利用之前的对话历史来问两个不同的问题. 打开的探测器允许属性标签或未知. 强制探测器需要两个标签中的一个. 我们用不同的种子对每个问题进行三次抽样,并使用多数答案。 每个探测器运行在一个单独的分支上,电子邮件生成从原始历史中得来.

blocks.en: We score the open probe against the planned labels in all 100 conversations, treating unknown as correct for conversations planned without a user cue. We report forced-probe accuracy for the 52 conversations with a planned reveal. Table 8 gives both sets of scores.
blocks.zh: 我们在所有100个对话中 对计划标签的公开探测得分 认为没有用户提示的 计划谈话正确 我们报告52次谈话的 强制检测准确性 并计划透露 表8给出了两套分数.

blocks.en: Table 8: Correct probe answers by planned condition. For the open probe, unknown counts as correct in the groups planned without a user cue. Forced-probe accuracy is reported for planned reveals.
blocks.zh: 表8:按计划条件分列的正确探测答案。 对于开放式探测器,未知数在计划组中正确无误,没有用户提示. 已报告计划披露的强制检测准确性。

blocks.en:
Among the 52 conversations with a planned reveal, correct labels are decoded from emails more often than they are given in open answers in all four model and attribute combinations. For Qwen, the corresponding counts are 43 versus 20 for gender and 48 versus 37 for age. For Llama, they are 49 versus 45 for gender and 50 versus 39 for age.
These results suggest that open probes can underestimate what an adversary can recover from generated text.
blocks.zh:
在与计划透露的52个对话中,正确标签从电子邮件中解码的次数比在所有四个模型和属性组合中公开答案中给出的要多. 就Quen而言,相应的数字是性别43对20,年龄48对37。 对Llama来说,性别是49比45,年龄是50比39。
这些结果表明,开放的探测器可以低估对手从生成的文本中可以回收的东西.

blocks.en: When the email fails to yield the intended label, the forced probe gives the correct label in all nine Qwen gender cases and all four Qwen age cases. For Llama, it gives the correct label in two of the three gender cases and both age cases. Overall, the forced probe elicits the intended label in 17 of the 18 cases with unsuccessful email decoding. This is consistent with an encoding failure in some cases. However, we should note that the direct question and the email request elicit different responses, so the comparison leaves the inference made during email generation unresolved.
blocks.zh: 当电子邮件未能产生预期的标签时,强制探测器在所有9个Quen性别案件和所有4个Quen年龄案件中给出了正确的标签. 对Llama来说,它给三个性别案件中的两个案件和两个年龄案件贴上了正确的标签。 总体而言,在18个案例中,强制探测器以不成功的电子邮件解码方式引出了17个案件的预定标签。 这与在某些情况下编码失败是一致的. 然而,我们应当注意到,直接问题和电子邮件请求引起了不同的答复,因此比较之后,电子邮件生成期间的推论仍未得到解决。

blocks.en: For planned reveals, Qwen’s open probe answers unknown in all 32 incorrect gender cases. For age, 14 incorrect answers are unknown and one is adult for a planned kid–teen case.
blocks.zh: Quen的公开调查发现, 对于年龄来说,有14个错误的答案是未知的,有一个是计划孩子的成年人。

blocks.en: Of the 48 conversations planned without a user cue, Qwen leaves 44 gender emails and 47 age emails unmarked. The corresponding counts for Llama are 39 and 48. The open probe answers unknown in 48 and 42 of these Qwen conversations and in 46 and 33 of these Llama conversations, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在没有用户提示的48个对话中,Quen留下了44个性别电子邮件和47个年龄的电子邮件。 对Llama的相应统计为39和48。 公开探针分别在48次和42次这些Quen对话以及46次和33次这些Llama对话中解答未知.

blocks.en: In the open probe for age, Qwen gives one adult and one unclear answer in the group with no planned cue or misleading reference, and four adult answers in the misleading-reference group.
blocks.zh: 在年龄的开放式探针中,Quen给出了组内一个成年人和一个不明确的答案,没有计划提示或误导性参考,在误导性参考组中给出了四个成年人答案.

blocks.en: C.2 Controlled Test Splits
blocks.zh: C.2 受控试验分片

blocks.en: Each trained model is evaluated on the reserved test split for its scheme and attribute. The ZeroWidth splits contain 507 gender and 384 age conversations. The StegMark splits contain 336 gender and 311 age conversations, including 254 and 238 email requests, respectively. Both base models use the same test counts for a given scheme and attribute. We reserve these data for final evaluation.
blocks.zh: 每个训练有素的模型都按其方案和属性的预留测试分数进行评估。 ZeroWidth分裂包含507个性别和384个年龄对话. StegMark的分裂包含336个性别和311个年龄的对话,分别包括254个和238个电子邮件请求. 这两种基本模型对给定的方案和属性使用相同的测试计数. 我们保留这些数据进行最后评估。

blocks.en: The model generates a complete reply greedily for each user turn. After scoring that reply, we replace it in the history with the reference assistant reply before evaluating the next turn. This allows us to evaluate a complete generated reply while preventing its errors from affecting later predictions.
blocks.zh: 该模型为每个用户转弯产生完全的回复贪婪. 在给答复打分之后,我们将历史上的答复改为参考助理的答复,然后评估下一轮的答复。 这使我们能够评价一个完整的生成的回复,同时防止其错误影响以后的预测。

blocks.en: We measure: 1. The fraction of replies with the expected ending, including no marker when none is required. 2. The fraction of replies containing a marker when none is expected. 3. The fraction of replies requiring a marker that contain the correct one. We also record opposite-label markers and misplaced characters. Results are separated by cue type and by position before, at, or after the reveal, as well as conversations without a reveal.
blocks.zh: 我们衡量: 1. 答复中与预期结束有关的部分,包括在不需要标记时没有标记。 2. 预计无标记时含有标记的答复的一小部分。 3. 要求有一个包含正确标记的答复的一小部分。 我们还记录对面标签标记和错误字符。 结果按提示类型和在披露之前、时间或之后的位置以及无披露的对话分开。

blocks.en: The fraction of replies with the expected ending, including no marker when none is required.
blocks.zh: 与预期结束对应的答复比例,包括不需要标记时的分数。

blocks.en: The fraction of replies containing a marker when none is expected.
blocks.zh: 包含一个标记的回复在无标记时的一小部分。

blocks.en: The fraction of replies requiring a marker that contain the correct one.
blocks.zh: 需要包含正确标记的答复的一小部分。

blocks.en: The decoder applies a fixed mapping to the final character. A missing marker can reflect either a failure to identify the attribute or a failure to emit its marker. An opposite-label marker implies an incorrect output.
blocks.zh: 解码器对最终字符应用固定映射. 缺失的标记可以反映无法识别属性或未能释放其标记. 反标签标记意味着输出不正确 。

blocks.en: Each base model generates 2792 replies for gender and 2179 for age. Table 9 reports the ending and marker counts.
blocks.zh: 每个基本模式都产生2792份性别答复,2179份年龄答复。 表9报告了结束和标记数。

blocks.en: For Qwen gender, the five errors comprise four unexpected markers and one missing marker. For Qwen age, the nine errors comprise three unexpected markers, five missing markers, and one opposite-label marker. Llama gender has three unexpected and two missing markers, while Llama age has one missing marker. No model produces a misplaced character.
blocks.zh: 对于Quen性别,五个错误包括四个出乎意料的标记和一个缺失的标记. 对于Quen时代,这9个错误包括3个出乎意料的标记,5个缺失的标记,以及1个对面标签标记. Llama性别有三个出乎意料的标记和两个缺失的标记,而Llama年龄有一个缺失的标记. 没有模型生成一个错误的字符 。

blocks.en: Every reply strictly after the reveal has the correct marker. Because reference assistant replies are restored between turns, these results are conditional on a correct prior history, including its earlier markers.
blocks.zh: 严格地说,每一份答复都有正确的标记。 由于参考助手的回复在转弯间恢复,这些结果以正确的前传,包括其早期的标记为条件.

blocks.en: Table 9: Character-based test results, as counts of replies.
blocks.zh: 表9:以字符为基础的测试结果,作为答复数。

blocks.en: Of the 369 gender conversations with a reveal, 32 contain a direct cue and 337 an indirect cue. Of the 292 age conversations with a reveal, 28 contain a direct cue and 264 an indirect cue.
blocks.zh: 在369次有披露的性别对话中,32次包含直接提示,337次包含间接提示。 在292个年龄的谈话中 28个有直接提示 264个间接提示

blocks.en: All four models perform without error on the direct-cue conversations. For indirect cues, Qwen produces the expected ending at the reveal in 336 of 337 gender conversations and 258 of 264 age conversations. Llama does so in 335 and 263, respectively. Table 10 gives the complete breakdown.
blocks.zh: 所有四个模型在直接-cue对话上都无错误地表演. 对于间接提示,Quen在337次性别对话中的336次和264次年龄对话中的258次的披露中产生了预期结束。 Llama分别在335年和263年这样做。 表10列出全部细目。

blocks.en: Table 10: Character-based replies with the expected ending, by cue type and position relative to the reveal. The Convs. column counts conversations containing a reveal.
blocks.zh: 表10:按提示类型和相对于披露位置分列的基于字符的与预期结束的回复。 Convs的专栏记录了包含一个启示的对话.

blocks.en: The turns before the email request are supplied with their reference assistant replies. The student then generates the email reply using the default sampling settings of its base model, without a list boost. Each request is sampled four times, giving 1016 generation attempts for gender and 952 for age per base model.
blocks.zh: 电子邮件请求前的转折附有其参考助理的答复。 学生然后使用其基础模型的默认采样设置生成电子邮件回复,而无需列表助推. 每项请求都进行了四次抽样,每个基准模型有1 016个代试性别,952个年龄。

blocks.en: A reply is correct when the detector returns the reference attribute label, or returns unmarked for a neutral request. When the opening email tag is present and the closing tag is missing, extraction continues through the end of the reply. We count outputs without an extractable email as incorrect. Separately, we check ordinary replies for emails generated without a request.
blocks.zh: 当检测器返回引用属性标签时,或者返回未标记的中性请求时,回复是正确的. 当打开的电子邮件标签存在,而关闭标签缺失时,提取持续到回复的结尾. 我们把没有可提取的电子邮件的产出算作不正确。 另外,我们检查没有请求而生成的电子邮件的普通答复。

blocks.en: As a reference, the frozen teacher generates emails for the same requests with the reference label supplied and the corresponding list boost applied for non-neutral cases. These replies measure encoding and detection with the label given .
blocks.zh: 作为参考,被冻结的老师会为同样的请求生成电子邮件,同时提供参考标签和适用于非中性病例的相应列表助推. 这些答复用给定的标签测量编码和检测。

blocks.en: Table 11 reports the student and teacher results by label. In the student runs, no email from a conversation with a revealed label is decoded as the opposite label.
blocks.zh: 表11按标签报告师生成绩。 在学生的运行中,没有从与被披露的标签的对话中解码为相反标签的电子邮件.

blocks.en: For Qwen gender, all 47 unsuccessful labeled emails are read as unmarked. In each, the correct list contains more distinct counted tokens than the opposite list. For Qwen age, 57 labeled emails are read as unmarked, and the correct list has more tokens in 51 of them.

blocks.en: C.3 Dependence on Earlier Markers
blocks.zh: C.3 对早期标记的依赖

blocks.en: In the ZeroWidth training data, the same marker appears in every reply from the reveal onward. A model can therefore produce the expected marker in a later reply by following an earlier marker. We test how much later replies depend on these earlier markers.
blocks.zh: 在ZeroWidth训练数据中,同样的标记出现在每一次从揭示到继续的回复中. 因此,一个模型可以通过遵循更早的标记,在以后的回复中产生预期的标记. 我们测试以后的答复在多大程度上取决于这些早期的标记。

blocks.en: For each base model and attribute, we shuffle the candidate conversations with a fixed seed before grading. We then select 40 conversations judged correct, with 10 direct reveals, 10 indirect reveals, 10 misleading references to another person, and 10 conversations without a reveal. For gender, each reveal group contains five male and five female conversations. For age, the direct group contains five kid–teen and five adult conversations for both models. The indirect group contains four kid–teen and six adult conversations for Qwen and five of each for Llama.
blocks.zh: 对于每个基数模型和属性,我们在分级前用固定的种子来洗刷候选人的对话. 然后我们选择了40个被评为正确的对话,其中10个直接披露,10个间接披露,10个误导他人的引用,以及10个没有披露的谈话. 就性别而言,每个披露小组包含5个男性和5个女性对话。 对于年龄而言,直接小组包含五个孩子的19个和两个模型的5个成年人对话。 间接团体包括4个儿童-16个和6个成人对话的Quen,以及每个Llama的5个。

blocks.en: The results are summarized in Table 12 . In the Keep condition, the regenerated replies match the stored wording and markers in all 276 gender and 287 age replies for Qwen, and all 273 gender and 276 age replies for Llama. For each model and attribute, the marker is correct at all 20 reveals and in every evaluated reply after the reveal. Since we selected conversations that were already judged correct, Keep verifies that the replay reproduces the original behavior and provides a baseline for Erase and Swap.

blocks.en: For the first reply after the reveal, A 4 ′ A^{\prime}_{4} in the example, Keep and Erase give the model the same conversation through U 4 U_{4} , with the marker on A 3 A_{3} removed under Erase. For Qwen gender, this edit reduces correct emission on that reply from 20/20 to 11/20. Across all replies after the reveal, the correct marker appears in 31/97 and 33/97 replies for Qwen gender and age, and in 10/94 and 12/89 for Llama. The remaining replies are unmarked. The proportion of correct markers is higher in A 4 ′ A^{\prime}_{4} than in the replies from A 5 ′ A^{\prime}_{5} onward.

blocks.en: On most unmarked replies under Erase, the correct marker still has a higher logit score than the opposite marker (Figure 4 ). In the example, the model can rank the male marker above the female marker and give the end-of-reply token a higher score than either. The mean logit advantage of ending the reply over emitting the correct marker is 4.3 and 5.1 for Qwen gender and age, and 3.8 and 5.2 for Llama.
blocks.zh: 在Erase下的大多数无标记回复上,正确的标记的对数分数仍然高于相反的标记(图4). 在例子中,模型可以将雄性标记排在雌性标记之上,并给予最终的记号比两者都更高的分数. 对Quen性别和年龄而言,结束答复大于排放正确标记的平均对数优势是4.3和5.1,对Llama而言是3.8和5.2。

blocks.en: Under Swap , Qwen follows the planted marker in 95/97 replies for each attribute. Its mean logit advantage over the correct marker is 7.5 for gender and 7.6 for age. Llama follows the planted marker in all 94 gender and 89 age replies, with a mean advantage of 7.8 for both attributes. From A 5 ′ A^{\prime}_{5} onward, the model also sees its regenerated replies, so these counts capture how the effect of the edit to A 3 A_{3} propagates through the conversation.
blocks.zh: 在交换中,Quen遵循了每个属性在95/97回复中的植入标记. 它相对于正确标记的平均对数优势是性别7.5,年龄7.6。 Llama在所有94个性别和89岁年龄的答复中都遵循了人种标记,两个属性的平均优势为7.8。 从A 5 ' A^{\prime}_{5}开始,该模型也看到它重新生成的回复,因此这些计数捕捉编辑到A 3 A_{3}的效果如何通过对话传播.

blocks.en: The markers are missed heavily in the Erase condition, and under Swap, the planted marker scores above the correct marker on average and appears in nearly every later reply. Earlier markers therefore affect both whether the model adds a marker and which label it emits. However, under Erase, the correct marker scores above the opposite marker in 251 of 291 unmarked replies. When a marker is required, choosing the higher-scoring of the two markers would therefore recover the correct label in about 86% of the cases. This suggests that many omissions could be corrected at decoding, provided there is a reliable way to decide when to emit a marker.
blocks.zh: 标记在Erase条件中被严重错过,在Swap下,被植入的标记分数平均高于正确的标记,并几乎在以后的回复中出现. 因此,早期的标记既会影响模型是否添加一个标记,又会影响哪个标记会发出. 然而,在Erase下,在291份无标记答复中,正确的标记分数高于相反标记的251。 当需要标记时,选择两个标记的分数较高,因此在大约86%的案例中恢复正确的标记. 这表明在解码时可以纠正许多遗漏,只要有可靠的方法来决定何时释放一个标记.

blocks.en: C.4 Ordinary Model Capabilities
blocks.zh: C.4 普通模型能力

blocks.en: The attack relies on the model producing useful replies while hiding its attribute predictions. We therefore test whether training for this behavior changes the model’s performance on benchmarks that measure general knowledge, reasoning, and instruction-following capabilities.
blocks.zh: 攻击依赖于模型在隐藏其属性预测的同时生成有用的回复. 因此,我们测试对这种行为的培训是否改变了模型在衡量一般知识、推理和教学跟踪能力的基准方面的表现。

blocks.en: We compare all four selected adaptations of each base model with the unmodified base model. For MMLU, ARC-Challenge, and HellaSwag, we use the EleutherAI evaluation harness with 5, 25, and 10 worked examples in the prompt, respectively. Candidate answers are scored by their log-likelihood after the question. We use the test sets of MMLU and ARC-Challenge and the validation set of HellaSwag.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个基模型的所有四个选取的适应性与未经修改的基模型进行比较. 对MMLU、ARC-Challenge和HelaSwag来说,我们分别使用EleutherAI评价工具,并有5、25和10个有效例子。 考生的回答在提问后通过他们的日志相似度来打分. 我们使用MMLU和ARC-Challenge的测试集和HelaSwag的验证集.

blocks.en: For IFEval, each model answers all 541 prompts greedily, with at most 1024 new tokens. We use the official evaluator and report strict prompt-level accuracy. Changes from the corresponding base model are reported with 95% intervals from a paired bootstrap.
blocks.zh: 对IFEval来说,每个模型都以贪婪的方式回答所有541个,最多有1024个新的符号. 我们使用官方评估,并报告严格的即时准确性。 报告来自相应基准模型的变化,间隔为95%,与配对的靴子间隔。

blocks.en: The character-based age model produces shorter IFEval replies, with a median of 44 words compared with 134 for the base model. It also often offers to perform a task where a finished text is requested. The selected Qwen age and gender checkpoints correspond to two and one training epochs, respectively.
blocks.zh: 基于角色的年龄模型生成更短的IFEval回复,中位数为44字,而基模型为134字. 它还经常提出在要求完成案文时执行某项任务。 选定的20岁检查站和性别检查站分别对应两个培训时代和一个培训时代。

blocks.en: The four Llama adaptations remain within 1.44 points of the base model on MMLU and HellaSwag. On ARC-Challenge, the character-based gender and age models gain 2.81 and 3.32 points, and the hash-based models gain 1.45 and 0.34 points.
blocks.zh: 4个Llama的适应仍保持在MMLU和HelaSwag上的基准模型的1.44点以内. 在ARC-Challenge上,基于性格的性别和年龄模型获得2.81分和3.32分,基于散列的模型获得1.45分和0.34分.

blocks.en: On IFEval, the character-based gender and age models lose 9.06 and 27.73 points. The hash-based gender model gains 2.03 points, and the hash-based age model loses 0.37 points. For the character-based age model, selected after one epoch, median reply length drops from 196 to 54 words.
blocks.zh: 在IFEval上,基于性格的性别和年龄模型损失了9.06和27.73分. 基于散列的性别模式得分2.03分,基于散列的年龄模式损失0.37分. 对于一个纪元之后选择的基于字符的年龄模型,中位回复长度从196字降至54字.

blocks.en: Across both encoding schemes, scores on the multiple-choice benchmarks stay relatively close to those of the base models. The schemes differ more on IFEval, where the ZeroWidth models lose 8.3–27.7 points and the StegMark models stay within 2.8 points of their base models. The largest declines occur in the ZeroWidth age models, which also produce substantially shorter replies. The StegMark results suggest that a model can learn to hide attribute predictions while retaining much of its ability to follow instructions. This matters for the attack because a reply that serves the user’s request gives them a reason to share the text containing the hidden prediction.
blocks.zh: 在两种编码办法中,多选择基准的分数都相对接近基准模型的分数。 这些计划在IFEval上差异较大,其中ZeroWidth模型损失8.3–27.7分,StegMark模型停留在它们基础模型的2.8分以内. ZeroWidth年龄模型的下降幅度最大,其答复也大大缩短。 StegMark的结果表明,一个模型可以学习隐藏属性预测,同时保留大部分遵循指令的能力. 这对攻击很重要,因为一个能满足用户要求的回复,让他们有理由分享包含隐藏预测的文字.
